log.author: Colin Heffner
log.title: Lower body / core program issued
log.text:
Weekly program: Plyometrics, Lower Body & Core — build power, stability and control. Days 1–3 (lower-body sagittal; hip and core; frontal plane and rotation) repeat as Days 4–6; Day 7 active recovery. Daniel’s wrist rehab and AiM arch drops are in the warm-up. Exercise videos organized in Seve’s UGP app space under “FITNESS – Exercise Database for Lower Body / Core Program”.
Seve committed to a minimum of three workouts per week; Colin checks in weekly.

log.author: Matt Hoffenberg
log.title: Lesson plan set — goals and practice games
log.text:
Goals: dial in putting/short game, more GIR, shoot 67, play aggressive.
Tools: Upgame app for stats. 30/60/90 wedge challenge (9 shots, carry-distance error = score; beat Matt's 13). Driver speed 3-strike game; warm up with 20 left-handed swings at 50%.
Putting: 50x 3-footers in a row; 6 tees at 5 ft ×5 rounds (track makes/30); lag drill from 15/20/25 ft.
On course: find patterns in shots that don't suit the eye; one no-score creative round a week; closest-to-pin chipping contests.

log.author: Matt Hoffenberg
log.title: Conversation with Coach Chelso about Seve’s Development
log.text:
Chelso shared some technical and non-technical aspects of Seve’s game that they have been focusing on:
• Seve has a grip on the weaker side. They have been adjusting it to a stronger position each time they meet for a lesson.
• He tends to not shift enough weight to his right side in the backswing, and can do a better job loading into his right side. Chelso thinks strengthening his right leg through working out could be beneficial.
• Seve rolls the ball well on the greens; he just needs to build confidence and have more structure in his putting practice.
• His super power is resilience and work ethic.

(Relayed by Matt in #junior-golf, Nov 3.)

log.author: Mac Todd
log.title: Right-wrist radius fracture
log.text: Fell on concrete during touch football at the school's Marin camp; played through ~3 days before X-ray confirmed a fractured radius. Splint, then cast. No golf for about a month.

log.author: Mac Todd
log.title: Cast off
log.text: Doctor: cleared for the Nov 7 tournament; chipping and putting allowed right away; no full swings this week.

log.author: Daniel Jo
log.title: 9-week Return to Golf / Competition program issued
log.text: Phased progression for the right wrist, planned to the Dec 28 Poppy Hills event (9-week mark); Dec 5 Hunter Ranch sits at ~6 weeks and is likely safe. Anything sooner risks re-aggravation. Phases will move faster if Seve responds well (he was only casted ~1 month). Matt, Colin and Daniel coordinate golf/fitness/recovery; team FaceTime every other week.
